Dana Whitfield (10:02 A.M.)
Marco, are you still on Route 6? A customer at 48 Pelham Avenue just called. She says her grocery order was supposed to arrive by 9:30.

Marco Reyes (10:04 A.M.)
I'm two stops away. There was a water main break on Carver Street, so the whole route is running about forty minutes behind.

Dana Whitfield (10:05 A.M.)
Understood. Should I call the remaining customers and let them know?

Marco Reyes (10:06 A.M.)
That would help a lot. Also, the Pelham Avenue order has frozen items. Can you tell her to be ready at the door so nothing sits outside?

Dana Whitfield (10:08 A.M.)

questions.question: Who will most likely deliver the package to Linden Court?
options: Ms. Whitfield
Mr. Reyes
Priya

passage:
Theo Nakamura (2:01 P.M.)
Team, the customer database has been unreachable for about ten minutes. Support lines are lighting up.

Greta Lindqvist (2:03 P.M.)
Confirmed on my end. The server isn't responding to any requests. I'm checking whether last night's security patch is the cause.

Before you dig in — the hosting provider just posted a notice. They're having a hardware failure at their Denver data center. Estimated fix time is 4:00 P.M.

Theo Nakamura (2:06 P.M.)

Greta Lindqvist (2:08 P.M.)
Should we switch to the backup server in Atlanta? Customers could at least view their accounts, even if they can't make changes.

Raj Patel (2:10 P.M.)
Good idea, but it takes about thirty minutes to redirect traffic. If the provider fixes things by 4:00, is it worth it?

Theo Nakamura (2:11 P.M.)
Two hours of downtime during business hours? Absolutely. Greta, start the switchover. Raj, draft a notice for the website banner and send it to me for approval first.

On it. You'll have a draft within fifteen minutes.

questions.question: What problem are the writers discussing?
options: A database cannot be accessed.
A security patch deleted customer records.
A support telephone line is out of service.
A website banner displays incorrect information.
questions.explanation: 첫 메시지에서 Theo는 'the customer database has been unreachable for about ten minutes'라고 말하며, Greta도 'The server isn't responding to any requests'라고 확인합니다. 고객 데이터베이스에 접속할 수 없는 문제를 논의하고 있으므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 보안 패치는 원인 후보로만 언급되었고 실제 원인은 호스팅 업체의 하드웨어 장애였습니다.

questions.question: According to Mr. Patel, what caused the problem?
options: An error in a recently installed patch
An equipment failure at a data center
An unusually high volume of support calls
A mistake made during a server switchover
questions.explanation: 2:05 P.M.에 Raj Patel은 'They're having a hardware failure at their Denver data center'라고 호스팅 업체의 공지를 전합니다. 덴버 데이터 센터의 하드웨어(장비) 고장이 원인이므로 (B)가 정답입니다. Greta가 의심했던 보안 패치는 원인이 아닌 것으로 밝혀졌습니다.

questions.question: At 2:06 P.M., what does Mr. Nakamura most likely mean when he writes, "So it's not on us"?
options: His team did not cause the outage.
His company will not pay for the repairs.
The backup server is not his team's responsibility.
Customers will not blame the hosting provider.
questions.explanation: Raj가 호스팅 업체의 데이터 센터 하드웨어 장애가 원인이라고 알리자 Theo는 'So it's not on us. That's almost a relief.'라고 답합니다. 'not on us'는 장애의 책임·원인이 자신의 팀(자사 시스템)에 있지 않다는 의미이므로 (A)가 정답입니다. 직전에 Greta가 자신들이 적용한 보안 패치가 원인인지 조사하던 맥락과 연결됩니다.

questions.question: What will Mr. Patel most likely do next?
options: Redirect traffic to a server in Atlanta
Call the hosting provider in Denver
Write an announcement for the company's website
Approve a message drafted by Mr. Nakamura
questions.explanation: 2:11 P.M.에 Theo는 'Raj, draft a notice for the website banner and send it to me for approval first'라고 지시했고, Raj는 'On it. You'll have a draft within fifteen minutes'라고 답합니다. Raj가 다음에 할 일은 웹사이트 배너용 공지문 작성이므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 백업 서버 전환은 Greta의 업무이며, 승인은 Theo가 합니다.

questions.question: At 8:24 A.M., what does Ms. Fontaine most likely mean when she writes, "Give me ten minutes"?

questions.question: Why should the banner be hung last?
options: It has not yet been delivered to the hall.
It must be approved by the hall coordinator.
Work above the booth is not yet finished.
The display shelves must support its weight.
questions.explanation: 8:26 A.M.에 Yusuf는 'Leave the banner for last — we can't hang it until the lighting crew finishes overhead'라고 말합니다. 부스 위쪽에서 조명 작업반의 작업이 끝나야 배너를 걸 수 있으므로 (C)가 정답입니다. 배너 상자는 이미 도착해 있다고('The banner crate is here too') 했으므로 (A)는 오답입니다.

questions.question: What will Ms. Anand most likely do before tomorrow's discussion?
